definition.title: Watch competitors for pricing and product changes
definition.description: Each week Tin rereads your known competitors' public pricing and changelog pages and reports only material changes, with a suggested response. It never signs up, contacts anyone or changes your pricing.

competitor_urls.title: Competitor pages (optional)
competitor_urls.description: Public homepage, pricing or changelog URLs; pages on one host count as one competitor. Leave empty to watch the competitors Tin already knows: earlier watches, the onboarding plan, project memory, then keyword-plan and paid-ads research.

watch_for.title: What matters most (optional)
watch_for.description: The change that would actually change what you do, e.g. a price cut on their starter plan, a free tier, or a feature you do not have.

our_positioning.title: Your pricing and positioning (optional override)
our_positioning.description: Only when project memory is missing or out of date. By default Tin reads your plans from the Feature map, Code map and onboarding plan.

prerequisites.reason: The onboarding plan states your business, price and packaging, and the hard no's a suggested response must respect.
The Feature map's plans and features are what each competitor change is weighed against.
A keyword plan records search competitors, so the watch can start without you listing competitor URLs.
